Our Story

Company Background

Millions of South African consumers face immense hurdles due to adverse credit bureau listings. Many find themselves entrapped in debt review long after paying their final installment, while others continue to receive aggressive collection calls for prescribed debts that have expired by law.

Credit Care SA was established to provide consumers with ethical, legal, and rapid remedies. With comprehensive expertise in the National Credit Act (NCA), Magistrate's Court Act, and credit bureau regulations, our specialized team investigates your credit profile with microscopic precision.

We bridge the gap between frustrated consumers and complex bureau dispute procedures. By handling disputes directly with TransUnion, Experian, XDS, and Compuscan, we remove bureaucratic roadblocks and obtain genuine, verifiable clearance certificates.

Core Philosophy

Mission and Vision

Guiding South African families and entrepreneurs toward permanent financial freedom and creditworthiness.

Our Mission

To legally empower every South African consumer burdened by inaccurate, adverse, or prescribed credit records. We actively enforce credit legislation to clear wrongful listings, resolve debt reviews, and restore pristine credit ratings with zero friction.

Our Vision

A thriving, financially liberated South Africa where credit ratings accurately reflect financial integrity, giving every individual equal access to prime vehicle financing, bond approvals, home ownership, and entrepreneurial capital.

Customer First

Our Commitment to Customers

What you can always count on when choosing Credit Care SA as your financial advocate.

Complete Legal Transparency

No false promises and no shortcuts. We only utilize lawful dispute mechanisms certified by the National Credit Act. You receive clear documentation at every phase.

Direct Specialist Access

You communicate directly with dedicated senior credit consultants via WhatsApp and phone. No endless phone queues or impersonal automated ticket systems.

Official Bureau Proof

When your case is finalized, we provide official clearance certificates (Form 17.W / bureau confirmation sheets) proving your updated record across all major bureaus.
